svg.text: run_tick(connector_id) — async coroutine
dispatched by APScheduler IntervalTrigger (PR7 — not yet implemented) OR POST /v1/connectors/{id}/syncs
Phase 0 (lock): try_acquire_sync_lock() already called by caller (scheduler or POST /syncs handler); run_tick assumes lock held
① Phase 1 — open tick record
sync_seq = init_sync_log_and_update_connector(connector_id)
Two DB calls: INSERT connector_sync_logs (seq, started_at, status='started') + SET connector sync_status='syncing'
CHECKPOINT 1: _check_interrupt_call(connector_id, sync_seq) — reads connectors.sync_status AND connector_sync_logs.status
② Phase 2 — load known state + scan
list_connector_checksums(connector_id); list_all_checksums()
await asyncio.to_thread(scanner.connect) → await asyncio.to_thread(scanner.scan) → list[(remote_path, checksum)]
③ Phase 3 — _classify(connector_id, scanned_files, known_checksums, all_checksums)
For each (path, checksum) in scanned_files:
• in known_checksums → skip (already owned) | • in all_checksums → add_connector_checksum_entry inline (cross-connector dup)
• neither → append to ingest_list | orphan_checksums = known_checksums − scanned_checksums
Phase 3b: update_sync_log(connector_id, sync_seq, total_files, new_files, removed_files) + update_connector_total_files(connector_id, total)
All counts known post-classify — single write each before any I/O-heavy work begins
④ Phase 4a — _process_new_files(sync_seq, connector_id, connector_name, scanner, ingest_list) [BATCH_SIZE=10]
For each batch (batch_number 1-based, up to 10 files):
CHECKPOINT 2: _check_interrupt_call before batch starts
staging dir: staging/connectors/{connector_id}-{sync_seq}-{batch_number}
await asyncio.to_thread(scanner.download_to, remote_path, local_path) per file
verify_integrity() → if failed: skip file (warning log, not fatal) | CHECKPOINT 3: after downloads
initialize_job_state(job_name="Connector-{connector_name}-{sync_seq}-{batch_number}") → add_connector_checksum_entry
await asyncio.to_thread(ingest, batch_dir, job_id, doc_id_dict) → await _wait_for_job(job_id, connector_id, sync_seq) [CHECKPOINT 4]
batch exception → batch_failed=True (continues); finally: cleanup_staging_directory per batch
After all batches: if batch_failed → raise RuntimeError → _fail_tick → OUT_OF_SYNC
⑤ Phase 4b — _delete_orphans(connector_id, orphan_checksums)
Runs AFTER all Phase 4a batches complete
orphan_checksums = known_checksums − {scanned checksums}
For each: remove_connector_checksum_entry(connector_id, checksum) → if remaining == 0:
await asyncio.to_thread(_best_effort_delete_document, doc_id) | Errors re-raised (not swallowed)
⑥ Phase 5 — _complete_tick(sync_seq, connector_id)
finalize_sync_log_and_update_connector(connector_id, seq, status=COMPLETED)
Two DB calls: finalize log row (finished_at, status='completed') + UPDATE connectors SET last_sync_at, sync_status='completed'
APScheduler (PR7) will fire next tick at next interval
⑦ finally: await asyncio.to_thread(scanner.close)
Always runs — SFTP close, boto3 client release, etc.; coroutine exits
CancelledError → await _handle_interrupt
Exception → _fail_tick
Exception handling
CancelledError: _check_interrupt_call(connector_id, sync_seq) → identify type
SYNC_CANCEL → _cancel_tick (log→'cancelled', connector→'out of sync') + _sweep_staging_dir(sync_seq=sync_seq only)
DELETE_CONNECTOR → _cancel_tick + await _run_teardown(connector_id) [imported from connectors.py — same as Case B]
Other Exception: _fail_tick (log→'failed', connector→'out of sync') • error logged • no re-raise
finally: scanner.close() always runs; CancelledError is re-raised after _handle_interrupt completes
Legend:
asyncio.to_thread: blocking I/O offloaded to ThreadPoolExecutor — event loop stays responsive
Checkpoint: _check_interrupt_call(connector_id, sync_seq) — live DB reads of connectors.sync_status AND connector_sync_logs.status
→ DELETE_PENDING → InterruptType.DELETE_CONNECTOR | CANCEL_PENDING → InterruptType.SYNC_CANCEL
Called at 4 points: after init_sync_log_and_update_connector, before batch, after downloads, inside _wait_for_job poll loop
CancelledError raised in coroutine; a thread already in flight runs to natural completion
_handle_interrupt is async def — awaits _run_teardown for DELETE_CONNECTOR path
